name: SS Clinic
product_facts: Clinics: Subang Jaya and Kota Bharu
Consultations, health checks, telehealth, personal care plans
Approach: check first, assessment before any treatment
color_rules: 60:30:10 (navy foundation, white/clinical navy structure, gold accent)
Gold on Clinical Navy: large text and shapes only

fonts.body: Inter on the web, 15 px, 1.7 line height

rules: Never retype the wordmark; use supplied files
Text on solid panels, not on busy photos
Clear space and minimum size still to be confirmed

photography: Dignified Malaysian men aged 32 to 55, warm clinic lighting, natural eye contact, health-check equipment in use. Real clinic photography with written consent only.
avoid: Promises to cure, or to work by a certain time
False urgency such as countdowns or 'last slots'
Images of distressed men or pill bottles
Showing or naming individual doctors in brand material
doctor_allowed_in_ads: NO: guideline says do not show or name individual doctors in brand material
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), plus brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026)
staff_claims_review: Permanently blacklisted SS Clinic copy (brand-voice.md, SSC-STR-001): 'Mati pucuk', 'Lemah batin', 'Pancut awal', 'Keras dalam 1 sesi!'
Prescription medicines (e.g. tadalafil under ANDROLAB RX) cannot be advertised to the public in Malaysia; keep RX content internal
Compliant alternatives: 'Penurunan tenaga lelaki', 'Kesihatan intim lelaki', 'Vitaliti suami', 'Stamina dan daya tahan'
